info.title: Restaurant Operations Platform: QR relay functions
info.description: Generated from @rp/contracts/relay by `pnpm contracts:docs`; do not edit by hand. The QR menu site calls these Supabase edge functions (ADR-0015). `x-capability` is `TABLE_TOKEN` for a table's QR token in the `x-rp-table-token` header, with the browser's anonymous id in `x-rp-browser` where a rate limit applies. `x-requirements` lists the BRD requirement IDs.

get.description: The order as its diner sees it (QR-007), for orders of the token’s table only. An order past its pickup time reads EXPIRED at once, before the expiry job marks it.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

404.description: The table token is unknown, the table is no longer in service, or the restaurant is suspended (`TABLE_NOT_FOUND`). Or there is no such order at this table, or it is past retention (`ORDER_NOT_FOUND`).

get.summary: The table's menu, and whether ordering is open
get.description: The latest menu the restaurant published, with the table label and the pickup timeout. `readOnly` is true when the restaurant has not been heard from for its read-only time (QR-008); the site then shows the menu with a banner and no ordering. With `?known=` the version the browser has, an unchanged menu comes back as `document: null`.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

404.description: The table token is unknown, the table is no longer in service, or the restaurant is suspended (`TABLE_NOT_FOUND`).

503.description: The restaurant has not published a menu yet (`MENU_NOT_PUBLISHED`).

put.description: A new version of the document the QR site shows and checks orders against (QR-003). The same version with the same document again is a replay; an older or different one is refused (`STALE_MENU_VERSION`, with `details.latest`).

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked credential, or the restaurant is suspended (`CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`).

get.summary: Diners’ orders waiting to be picked up
get.description: Submitted orders still within their pickup time, oldest first, at most 100: the polling fallback to Realtime (QR-009). An order stays here until it is marked received or expires.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked credential, or the restaurant is suspended (`CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`).

post.summary: What became of a diner’s order
post.description: Received (with the local order), sent to the kitchen, rejected with the reason, or expired, and the kitchen’s item states (QR-007). An order past its pickup time cannot be received: it is marked expired and the answer is `ORDER_EXPIRED`, so the restaurant rejects it.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked credential, or the restaurant is suspended (`CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`).

404.description: No such order of this restaurant (`ORDER_NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: The status cannot move that way (`INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE`).

410.description: Not picked up in time; now expired (`ORDER_EXPIRED`).

post.summary: The local server is here, with the QR settings to enforce
post.description: Sent every `qr.presenceIntervalSeconds` (QR-008). Without it for `qr.readOnlyAfterSeconds` the QR menu turns read-only. The settings take effect for the next order.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked credential, or the restaurant is suspended (`CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`).

post.summary: A short-lived token for the Realtime channel of new orders
post.description: Signed for the role `relay_server` and the credential's restaurant, so the subscription sees only its own orders (QR-009). It expires within the hour; the sync agent renews it and polls `GET server/orders` meanwhile.

200.description: The token and what to subscribe to.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked credential, or the restaurant is suspended (`CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`).

503.description: Realtime tokens are not set up for this relay (`REALTIME_NOT_CONFIGURED`); poll instead.

put.summary: Keep the tables and their QR code hashes in step
put.description: Every table of the restaurant with the SHA-256 of its QR token (QR-001). A new hash replaces the old one, so a regenerated code stops the old one at once; tables left out are taken out of service.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked credential, or the restaurant is suspended (`CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`).

post.summary: Send a diner’s order to the restaurant
post.description: Checks the table token, every line against the latest menu (the same check as the restaurant's own, ORD-017), and the rate limits per table and per browser (QR-006); then stores the order with its idempotency key. A repeat with the same key at the same table returns the original order with `replayed` (ORD-013). Needs `x-rp-browser`.

200.description: Accepted (new or replayed), or the lines the menu cannot serve.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

404.description: The table token is unknown, the table is no longer in service, or the restaurant is suspended (`TABLE_NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: The idempotency key was used at another table (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`).

429.description: Too many orders from this table or this browser in the window (`RATE_LIMITED`, with `details.retryAfterSeconds` and a `Retry-After` header).

503.description: The restaurant is offline, so ordering is closed (`RESTAURANT_OFFLINE`), or it has no menu yet (`MENU_NOT_PUBLISHED`).
